question: Within 90 kilometers, where can I find a restaurant ahead of Funkmeyer New Reality Garden, Los Angeles, CA toward Drought Tolerant Garden, Glendora, CA?
sql: WITH StartGarden AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Funkmeyer New Reality Garden%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Los Angeles%' LIMIT 1 ), TargetGarden AS ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%Drought Tolerant Garden%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Glendora%' LIMIT 1 ), CalculatedBearings AS ( SELECT sg.geometry AS start_geom, tg.geometry AS target_geom, ST_Centroid(sg.geometry) AS start_point, ST_Centroid(tg.geometry) AS target_point, degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_Centroid(sg.geometry), ST_Centroid(tg.geometry))) AS target_bearing FROM StartGarden sg, TargetGarden tg WHERE sg.geometry IS NOT NULL AND tg.geometry IS NOT NULL ) SELECT p.poi_name, p.addr_city, p.addr_state FROM pois p, CalculatedBearings cb WHERE p.amenity = 'restaurant' AND ST_DWithin(p.geometry::geography, cb.start_geom::geography, 90000) AND ST_Centroid(p.geometry) IS NOT NULL -- Ensure the restaurant has a valid centroid for bearing calculation AND ( -- Calculate the normalized difference in bearing between the restaurant and the target direction LEAST( ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(cb.start_point, ST_Centroid(p.geometry))) - cb.target_bearing), 360 - ABS(degrees(ST_Azimuth(cb.start_point, ST_Centroid(p.geometry))) - cb.target_bearing) ) ) <= 45; -- Filter for restaurants within +/- 45 degrees of the target bearing

answers.poi_name: Pura Vida Cafe and Juice Bar
All You Can Eat Sushi and BBQ
